traditional: 將 A 同 B 掛鈎
jyutping: zoeng1 A tung4 B gwaa3 ngau1

english.note: Use this when actively linking or comparing A with B as corresponding factors.

examples.english: In research, we correlate sleep duration with work performance.
examples.traditional: 做研究嗰陣，我哋會將睡眠時間同工作表現掛鈎。
